source: Funnels v2 First 25 engine, read only: v2/funnels/first25-mapping.md and v2/funnels/code/public/funnels/first25-data.js (copied 2026-10-19). From there: services video, social, web, ai, email, photo and other (labels, words, gap weights, fit points, offer, walk-in, follow-up and subject lines, buyers), the free-sample steps (specs) and hooks, the 7-day plan and the 3-question picker. The gap ids, detection rules and member-facing gap wording live in packs/_kit/leads.js (same source); the 7 replies live in packs/_kit/outreach.js. New in the library: services frontdesk, reviews, google, seo, ads, copy, brand, booking, bookkeeping and cleaning, every why and angle line, partners, and the gaps after no_facebook in the kit.
how_scoring_works: Score = the points of every gap found that this service fixes, plus its fit points, kept between 1 and 99. Gaps are facts read off the business's own website (or that it has no website); listing facts (review count, rating) only count for scoring and never appear in messages or exports. Sort: score, then review count, then name.

web.label: Websites
web.why: People look at the website before they call. A broken, slow or dated one makes the business look closed.
web.angle: Open on the one thing that is broken on their site, then offer a free mockup they can keep.
web.offer: I'd like to make you a free mockup of a new homepage, and you keep it either way.
web.walkin: Could I send you a free mockup of a new homepage for {biz}? Takes me a day.
web.follow1: I made the homepage mockup. Here it is: [paste your link]. If you'd like it live, I can have it up in a week.
web.subject: A free homepage mockup for {biz}

social.label: Social media
social.why: Customers check Instagram before they visit. No account, or no link to it, looks like nobody is home.
social.angle: Name the missing link or account, then offer 3 free posts in their colors.
social.offer: I'd like to write and design your next 3 posts for free, so you can see the style first.
social.walkin: Could I take a few photos this week and turn them into 3 free posts for you?
social.follow1: I made the 3 posts. Here they are: [paste your link]. Use them either way. If you want more like this every week, let me know.
social.subject: 3 free posts for {biz}?

video.label: Short videos
video.why: A 15-second clip shows the place better than any photo, and most local businesses have none on their site.
video.angle: Say you couldn't find a video of their work, then offer one free reel from clips they already have.
video.offer: I'd like to make you one free 15-second reel from clips you already have.
video.walkin: Could I film 2 minutes of {film} this week and send you a free edit?
video.follow1: I went ahead and made the sample reel. Here it is: [paste your link]. If you like it, I can make 4 to 8 a month for you.
video.subject: A free reel for {biz}?

photo.label: Photography
photo.why: Most local sites use 3 or 4 old photos. New ones show what a visit is like today.
photo.angle: Point at how few photos are on their site, then offer 3 free shots of their best work.
photo.offer: I'd like to shoot 3 free photos of your {what} so you can see the style.
photo.walkin: Could I take 10 photos of your {what} this week and send you the best 3 for free?
photo.follow1: Here are your 3 photos: [paste your link]. They are yours to use. If you want a full set every month, let me know.
photo.subject: Free photos for {biz}?

email.label: Email marketing
email.why: Customers who visited once are the easiest to bring back, and without a signup there's no way to reach them.
email.angle: Say there's no way to join their list, then offer to write their first 3 emails free.
email.offer: I'd like to write your first 3 emails for free, so you can see what it would look like.
email.walkin: Could I write your first 3 customer emails for free and show you how to send them?
email.follow1: I wrote the 3 emails. Here they are: [paste your link]. If you want, I can set up the signup form and send them for you.
email.subject: 3 free emails for {biz}?

ai.label: AI booking and follow-up
ai.verb: set up AI booking and follow-up
ai.why: Questions that come in after hours go unanswered, and every booking still needs a phone call.
ai.angle: Name the missing booking or chat, then offer a free demo built from their own website.
ai.offer: I'd like to build you a free demo that answers booking questions for {biz}, so you can try it before you decide anything.
ai.walkin: Could I build you a free demo that answers your booking questions, using what is already on your website?
ai.follow1: I built the demo. Here it is answering real questions from your website: [paste your link]. Want me to set it up for real?
ai.subject: A free booking demo for {biz}

frontdesk.label: Missed-call text back
frontdesk.verb: set up missed-call text back and online booking
frontdesk.why: A caller who gets voicemail often calls the next business on the list. A text back keeps the conversation going.
frontdesk.angle: Name the missing booking, chat or tap-to-call, then offer the text their business would send after a missed call, free.
frontdesk.offer: I'd like to write the text {biz} would send when you miss a call, free, so you can see how it works.
frontdesk.walkin: Could I write the text your business sends back when you miss a call? It's free and takes me 10 minutes.
frontdesk.follow1: Here's the missed-call text I wrote for you: [paste your link]. If you want it running on your number this week, I can set it up.
frontdesk.subject: When {biz} misses a call

reviews.label: Reviews and reputation
reviews.why: People read reviews before they pick a business, and happy customers rarely leave one unless asked.
reviews.angle: Say you couldn't find reviews on their site, then offer a free review card for the counter.
reviews.offer: I'd like to make you a free review card for your counter, with a QR code that opens your Google listing.
reviews.walkin: Could I make you a free card for the counter that asks every customer for an honest review? I'll drop it off this week.
reviews.follow1: Here's the review card I made for {biz}: [paste your link]. Print it as is. If you want the follow-up texts too, I can set those up.
reviews.subject: A free review card for {biz}

google.label: Google Business Profile
google.verb: set up and look after Google Business Profiles
google.why: When someone searches for a business, its Google profile is often the first thing they see.
google.angle: Name the missing hours, description or website, then offer a free list of the 5 fixes you'd make first.
google.offer: I'd like to check your Google profile for free and send you the 5 fixes I'd make first.
google.walkin: Could I check your Google profile for free and leave you a list of the 5 fixes I'd make?
google.follow1: Here are the 5 fixes for your Google profile: [paste your link]. You can do them yourself, or I can do them this week.
google.subject: 5 quick fixes for {biz} on Google

seo.label: Local SEO
seo.verb: help local businesses show up on Google
seo.why: Google reads the page itself. Missing titles, descriptions and business details make it harder to rank for local searches.
seo.angle: Name one technical gap you found, then offer a free one-page check with the 5 fixes.
seo.offer: I'd like to send you a free one-page check of your homepage, with the 5 fixes I'd make first.
seo.walkin: Could I send you a free one-page check of your website, with the 5 fixes I'd make first?
seo.follow1: Here's the one-page check of your homepage: [paste your link]. The first 2 fixes take under an hour. Want me to do them?
seo.subject: 5 fixes for {biz} on Google

ads.label: Paid ads (Meta and Google)
ads.verb: run Facebook, Instagram and Google ads
ads.why: Without a pixel and a clear offer, ad money can't be measured or aimed at people who already visited.
ads.angle: Name the missing pixel or offer, then offer 3 free ad drafts for their best service.
ads.offer: I'd like to write you 3 free ad drafts for your best offer, so you can see the angle first.
ads.walkin: Could I write you 3 free ad drafts for your best service? You keep them either way.
ads.follow1: Here are the 3 ad drafts: [paste your link]. If you want to try one, I can set it up with a small test budget you choose.
ads.subject: 3 free ad drafts for {biz}

copy.label: Website copywriting
copy.why: Visitors decide in seconds. A homepage with few words, no offer and no prices leaves them guessing.
copy.angle: Name the missing offer or prices, then offer to rewrite their headline and first section free.
copy.offer: I'd like to rewrite your homepage headline and first section for free, so you can see the difference.
copy.walkin: Could I rewrite the top of your homepage for free? You'd have it tomorrow.
copy.follow1: Here's the rewrite of your homepage top: [paste your link]. Paste it in as is, or I can do the rest of the page.
copy.subject: A new homepage headline for {biz}

brand.label: Logo and branding
brand.why: A dated look makes a good business seem older than it is, and mismatched colors look careless.
brand.angle: Name the dated footer or thin photos, then offer a free one-page brand sheet.
brand.offer: I'd like to make you a free one-page brand sheet: your colors, fonts and logo use, cleaned up.
brand.walkin: Could I make you a free one-page brand sheet with your colors and logo, cleaned up?
brand.follow1: Here's your brand sheet: [paste your link]. Use it with any designer. If you want a refresh, I'd start from this.
brand.subject: A free brand sheet for {biz}

booking.label: Online booking setup
booking.why: Many customers would rather book online than call, and a booking page works when the front desk is busy.
booking.angle: Say you couldn't find a way to book online, then offer a free demo booking page with their services.
booking.offer: I'd like to set up a free demo booking page with your services, so you can click through it first.
booking.walkin: Could I set up a free demo booking page with your services? You can try it on your phone first.
booking.follow1: Here's the demo booking page: [paste your link]. Try a test booking. If you like it, I can connect it to your calendar.
booking.subject: A free booking page for {biz}

bookkeeping.label: Bookkeeping
bookkeeping.why: Busy owners fall behind on the books, and catching up at tax time costs more than staying current.
bookkeeping.angle: Open on something true from their site (how they take bookings or payments), then offer a free review of one month.
bookkeeping.offer: I'd like to do a free 30-minute review of last month's books and send you what I'd tidy first.
bookkeeping.walkin: Could I do a free 30-minute review of one month of your books? No obligation.
bookkeeping.follow1: Following up on my note. The free 30-minute review is still on the table. Want me to pick a time?
bookkeeping.subject: A free month-end check for {biz}

cleaning.label: Office and commercial cleaning
cleaning.verb: clean offices and shops after hours
cleaning.why: A clean front room is the first thing customers notice, and owners rarely have time to keep it up.
cleaning.angle: Open on their hours (you work after they close), then offer one free after-hours clean.
cleaning.offer: I'd like to do one free after-hours clean of your front area, so you can see the quality first.
cleaning.walkin: Could I do one free after-hours clean of your front area this week, so you can see the quality?
cleaning.follow1: Following up on my note. The free after-hours clean is still yours. Want me to pick a night?
cleaning.subject: A free after-hours clean for {biz}

other.label: Something else
other.why: A free first job lets the owner judge your work before paying anything.
other.angle: Open on something true from their site, then offer a small free first job.
other.offer: I'd like to show you my work with a free first job, so you can decide after.
other.walkin: Could I do a small first job for free so you can see the quality?
other.follow1: Following up on my note. The free first job is still on the table. Want me to pick a day?
other.subject: A free first job for {biz}?

hooks.medspas: What a visit to {biz} actually looks like
hooks.chiro: What happens in your first session at {biz}

video.title: Make one free reel for {biz}.
steps: Grab 4 to 6 clips from their public Instagram or Facebook. The edit is only for them, so never post it.
Cut a 12 to 15 second vertical edit in CapCut: a hook in the first second, a cut on every beat, big captions.
Open on this line: "{hook}".
End on their name and one line: "Come try a {thing}."
Export at 1080x1920 and upload it as an unlisted link you can paste into your follow-up.
board: Their 3 best clips, one cut on every beat

social.title: Write and design 3 posts for {biz}.
steps: Scroll their last 9 posts. Note which ones got the most comments.
Write 3 posts that do more of that: one behind the scenes, one customer favorite, one reason to come in this week.
Design them in Canva in their colors, with their logo small in a corner.
Put the 3 images and the captions in one link you can paste into your follow-up.

web.title: Mock up a new homepage for {biz}.
steps: Screenshot their current homepage on your phone.
Ask Claude to write a new homepage for {biz}: one headline, 3 short sections and one button that says "Book" or "Get a quote".
Build the mockup in Framer, Canva or Lovable. Keep it to one screen on a phone.
Send the before and after side by side. People buy what they can see.

ai.title: Build a 2-minute booking demo for {biz}.
steps: Copy their hours, services, prices and FAQs from their website into a doc.
Paste it into Claude and ask it to answer like their front desk. Test 10 real questions, like "Do you have anything Saturday?"
Record a 60-second screen video of it answering 3 of them.
Send the video, not a pitch. The demo does the selling.

email.title: Write the first 3 emails for {biz}.
steps: Welcome: who they are and why people come back.
Favorite: their best seller or most booked {thing}, with one photo.
Come back: one reason to visit this month.
Mock them up in a free email template and send screenshots, with the text ready to paste.

photo.title: Shoot 10, send 3, for {biz}.
steps: Visit as a customer. Ask before you take a single photo.
Shoot 10 photos of their best {what} in natural light, from their customers' point of view.
Edit the best 3 on your phone. Match the colors to their sign or logo.
Send them with one line: "These are yours to use, free."

frontdesk.title: Write the missed-call text for {biz}.
steps: Copy their hours, services and booking link (or phone) from their website.
Write the text in under 300 characters: who it's from, that you saw the missed call, one question ("What can we help with?") and the booking link.
Write 3 more: after hours, a quote request, and a reply to "How much?" that asks one question first.
Put all 4 on one page and send the link in your follow-up.

reviews.title: Make a review card for {biz}.
steps: Find their Google listing and copy its "Write a review" link.
Make a QR code for that link and put it on a card in their colors: "Enjoyed your visit? A quick review helps us a lot."
Write the 2-line text their staff can send after a visit, with the same link.
Send a photo of the printed card. Offer to drop off 50.

google.title: List 5 fixes for {biz} on Google.
steps: Search their name and city on Google Maps on your phone.
Check: hours, a description, photos from the last 3 months, their website link, and whether they answer reviews.
Write the 5 fixes in order, each in one line, starting with the one a customer would notice first.
Send the list as a short note. They can do it themselves, which is why they'll trust you.

seo.title: Make a one-page homepage check for {biz}.
steps: Use the facts from this report: description, H1 headline, schema, alt text, https and phone setup.
Pick the 5 fixes that matter most and write each one as "What we found, why it matters, how to fix it".
Add the before and after of their Google result: their current title and description, then yours.
Send it as one page. Offer to do the first 2 fixes free.

ads.title: Write 3 ad drafts for {biz}.
steps: Pick their best service from their website. Use their own words and prices if they show them.
Write 3 short ads: one about the problem their customer has, one about how easy the first visit is, one with their offer.
Mock each up on a phone-sized image in their colors.
Send all 3 with one line: "Want me to run one as a small test?"

copy.title: Rewrite the top of {biz}'s homepage.
steps: Copy their current headline and first paragraph.
Write a new headline that says who it's for and what they get, a 2-sentence intro, and one clear button.
Put the before and after side by side on one page.
Send it with one line: "Paste it in as is, it's yours."

brand.title: Make a one-page brand sheet for {biz}.
steps: Take their logo and colors from their website and sign.
Clean up the logo file, pick 2 fonts and set 3 colors with their codes.
Show the logo on light and dark backgrounds, and one sample post using the sheet.
Send it as one page they can hand to any designer.

booking.title: Set up a demo booking page for {biz}.
steps: Copy their services, prices and hours from their website.
Set up a free booking page (Calendly, Square Appointments or Acuity) with those services.
Book a test appointment yourself and screenshot each step on your phone.
Send the link and the screenshots. Offer to connect it to their calendar.

other.title: Do one small free job for {biz}.
steps: Pick the smallest piece of work that shows your quality in under an hour.
Take a before photo and an after photo.
Send both with one line: "This one is on me. Want me to do the rest?"

plan: Make the free sample for #1. Send your message to #1 to #5.
Send #6 to #10. Walk into the 2 closest and use the walk-in line.
Follow up with #1 to #5. Send the sample you made.
Send #11 to #15. Make a sample for the best reply so far.
Follow up with #6 to #10. Ask anyone who replied for 15 minutes.
Last follow-ups. Write down every reply, even the no's. That list is your next week.

why.video|gyms: Gyms post all the time, classes are easy to film, and the owner is usually on site.
why.video|realtors: Agents need a video for every listing, and most of the work happens on your laptop.
why.email|boutiques: Boutiques sell to people who already love them, and email is how they bring them back.
why.email|yoga: Studios live on regulars, and a weekly email keeps them in the loop.
why.social|restaurants: Restaurants need fresh posts every week, and you can shoot them while you eat.
why.social|salons: Salons sell on looks, so they need a steady feed of their work.
why.web|contractors: People hire contractors from a Google search, so the website does the selling.
why.web|dentists: New patients judge a dental office by its website before they ever call.
why.photo|restaurants: Good food photos sell the dish, and you can shoot a menu in an afternoon.
why.photo|boutiques: Every new arrival needs photos, and you can shoot a rack in an hour.
why.ai|medspas: Med spas get the same booking questions every day, and a missed question is a missed booking.
why.ai|dentists: Dental offices answer the same questions all day, and patients want answers after hours too.

hoursNote.15: With 15 or more hours a week, you can work the whole list in 7 days.
hoursNote.lt5: With under 5 hours a week, aim for 1 client first.
hoursNote.5to15: With 5 to 15 hours a week, 2 or 3 clients is plenty to start.

copy.checked: We checked each website on {date}. Things change, so look before you send.
copy.saved: We read {n} websites for you. That is about {time} of clicking by hand.
copy.priceTip: One package, one price per job, one start date. Make the first job an easy yes, and raise your price after 3 happy clients.
